tasks.spec: Create a Python library that updates a JSON configuration file through a same-directory temporary file and atomic replace, leaving the original intact on validation failure. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library implementing a bounded FIFO queue with explicit full and empty outcomes. Include deterministic tests without threads or sleeps. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that reads CSV item,quantity,price from stdin and prints exact decimal totals per item sorted by name. Reject malformed rows without partial stdout. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library that returns all transitive reverse dependents of a changed node in a dependency graph, handling cycles without duplicate results. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library to parse integer duration strings with s,m,h,d units and format total seconds canonically. Reject negative, ambiguous and fractional input. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python JSON Lines CLI that deduplicates events by id while preserving first occurrence order and rejects events without string ids. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that hashes regular files below a supplied directory into a sorted relative-path SHA256 manifest without following symlinks. Test binary files and empty directories. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that normalizes INI configuration into sorted JSON while preserving section and key values and rejecting duplicate keys. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library merge_intervals that merges overlapping closed integer intervals and returns sorted nonoverlapping intervals. Reject reversed intervals. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library for decimal invoice subtotals, discounts and tax with explicit half-up cent rounding. Reject floats and negative quantity. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that counts a specified top-level field value in JSON Lines input and emits sorted JSON counts. Reject invalid JSON and missing fields. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python JSON Lines CLI that groups records by severity and emits deterministic counts and message-length maxima. Reject unknown severity values. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a bounded Python LRU cache supporting get and put; access refreshes recency, replacement keeps capacity, and zero capacity stores nothing. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that extracts Markdown ATX headings outside fenced code blocks and emits an indented table of contents with deterministic duplicate anchors. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library for rectangular matrix transpose and clockwise rotation. Test empty input, non-square matrices and ragged-row rejection. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library to encode and decode repeated URL query keys while preserving order and Unicode. Test blank values, spaces and percent escaping. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a pure Python exponential retry scheduling function with a maximum delay and attempt count. No sleeps or network. Validate nonnegative integer inputs. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python CLI that sorts semantic versions including prerelease identifiers using SemVer ordering; reject invalid versions and preserve build metadata. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library that indexes lowercase words to line numbers and supports exact-word queries. Test punctuation, Unicode and empty lines. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.

Create a Python library that produces a deterministic lexicographic topological order for a directed graph and reports a cycle without a partial result. Include a README, tests and an executable verification command. Use only the Python standard library.
